title: Adding a note to a Bigin deal does not change its Modified_Time
symptoms: Deals with fresh notes look untouched when sorted by Modified_Time
cause: Notes are separate records, and creating one does not update the parent's Modified_Time.
fix: Judge activity by the newer of the last edit and the newest note.
apply: last_activity = max(deal.Modified_Time, newest Created_Time among notes whose Parent_Id is the deal or its contact)
